STEP 17. Check the power supply voltage at Park/Neutral 
position switch connector B-41.
(1) Disconnect connector B-41 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 7 and ground.
• Voltage should be battery positive voltage.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the voltage normal?
YES : Go to Step 19.
NO : Go to Step 18.
STEP 18. Check connectors C-28 at intermediate 
connector and C-107 at junction block for damage.
Q: Are the connectors in good condition?
YES : Repair it because of harness open circuit or short 
circuit to ground between Park/Neutral position switch 
connector B-41 terminal 7 and junction block 
connector C-107 terminal 9.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
